list.name: Train / Test Split & Lifecycle Markers
list.rawQuery: SELECT event_ts AS time, component || ': ' || event_type AS title, COALESCE(details::text, model_version) AS text FROM eonet_lifecycle_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) ORDER BY event_ts;

options.content:
### Model Quality & Champion/Challenger Evaluation
Real-time shadow scoring, signed error drift tracking (`> 0` overpredicting, `< 0` underpredicting), and win-rate governance on **live stream events** from TimescaleDB.

| Event Lifecycle & Error Matrix | Rolling Drift & Split Markers | Live Cohort Win-Rate Governance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tracks **Stream Events** (`eonet_events_stream`): shows **Pending** close until NASA publishes closure, then computes signed errors (`pred - actual`) and **Best Model**. | Compares **Train** (before `2026-11-27` split) vs. **Test** (post-cutoff out-of-time evaluation) MAE curves across the vertical split marker. | Evaluates live stream events unseen during training—retaining **v1/v2** baselines while validating **v3 (SparkXGBoost)** in shadow mode. |

targets.rawSql: WITH roles AS (SELECT model_version, UPPER(deployment_role) AS role FROM eonet_model_registry), latest_stream AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_id) event_id, status, ingested_at_utc FROM eonet_events_stream ORDER BY event_id, ingested_at_utc DESC), latest_preds AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_id, model_version) event_id, model_version, elapsed_hours, pred_duration_hours FROM eonet_predictions ORDER BY event_id, model_version, predicted_at_utc DESC), eval_cohort AS (  SELECT s.event_id,     CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN MAX(p.elapsed_hours)          ELSE GREATEST(MAX(p.elapsed_hours), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.pred_duration_hours)) END AS target_h,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v1_baseline' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS p1,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v2_gbt' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS p2,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v3_xgboost' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS p3   FROM latest_stream s JOIN latest_preds p ON s.event_id = p.event_id GROUP BY s.event_id, s.status), winners AS (  SELECT CASE     WHEN ABS(p3 - target_h) < ABS(p2 - target_h) AND ABS(p3 - target_h) < ABS(p1 - target_h) THEN 'v3_xgboost'     WHEN ABS(p2 - target_h) < ABS(p3 - target_h) AND ABS(p2 - target_h) < ABS(p1 - target_h) THEN 'v2_gbt'     WHEN ABS(p1 - target_h) < ABS(p2 - target_h) AND ABS(p1 - target_h) < ABS(p3 - target_h) THEN 'v1_baseline'     ELSE 'Tie' END AS model_key   FROM eval_cohort WHERE p1 IS NOT NULL AND p2 IS NOT NULL AND p3 IS NOT NULL) SELECT COALESCE(w.model_key || ' (' || r.role || ')', 'Tie') AS winner, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM winners w LEFT JOIN roles r ON w.model_key = r.model_version GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Streams Events Prediction Winning Rate (Champion vs. Shadow)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 day', scored_at_utc) AS time, model_version || ' (' || data_split || ')' AS series, ROUND(AVG(abs_error_hours)::numeric, 2) AS mae_hours FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE actual_duration_hours IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(scored_at_utc) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Daily MAE Error Line Graph: Train (Solid) vs. Test Split (Dashed @ 2026-11-27)

targets.rawSql: SELECT category_id, ROUND(AVG(actual_duration_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Actual Duration (h)", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v1_baseline' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v1 Predicted (h) - Baseline", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v2_gbt' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v2 Predicted (h) - GBT", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN model_version = 'v3_xgboost' THEN pred_duration_hours END)::numeric, 1) AS "v3 Predicted (h) - XGBoost" FROM eonet_prediction_history WHERE status = 'closed' AND data_split = 'test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6;

panels.title: Predicted vs. Actual Duration by Category (Test Split)

targets.rawSql: WITH champ AS (SELECT model_version FROM eonet_model_registry WHERE deployment_role = 'champion' LIMIT 1), latest_stream AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_id) event_id, title, category_id, status, event_time_utc, closed_time_utc, ingested_at_utc FROM eonet_events_stream ORDER BY event_id, ingested_at_utc DESC), latest_preds AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_id, model_version) event_id, model_version, elapsed_hours, pred_duration_hours, pred_severity_tier FROM eonet_predictions ORDER BY event_id, model_version, predicted_at_utc DESC), pivoted AS (  SELECT s.event_id, s.title, s.category_id, s.status, s.event_time_utc, s.closed_time_utc,     MAX(p.elapsed_hours) AS elapsed_hours, MAX(p.pred_severity_tier) AS severity_tier,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v1_baseline' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS v1_pred,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v2_gbt' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS v2_pred,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = 'v3_xgboost' THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS v3_pred,     MAX(CASE WHEN p.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM champ) THEN p.pred_duration_hours END) AS champ_pred   FROM latest_stream s JOIN latest_preds p ON s.event_id = p.event_id   GROUP BY s.event_id, s.title, s.category_id, s.status, s.event_time_utc, s.closed_time_utc) SELECT event_id AS "Event ID", title AS "Hazard Title", category_id AS "Category", status AS "Status", severity_tier AS "Severity Tier", event_time_utc AS "Opened (UTC)", COALESCE(closed_time_utc::text, 'Pending (Open)') AS "Actual Close (UTC)", CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN ROUND(elapsed_hours::numeric, 1) ELSE NULL END AS "Actual Dur (h)", ROUND(v1_pred::numeric, 1) AS "v1 Pred (h)", CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN ROUND((v1_pred - elapsed_hours)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "v1 Error (h)", ROUND(v2_pred::numeric, 1) AS "v2 Pred (h)", CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN ROUND((v2_pred - elapsed_hours)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "v2 Error (h)", ROUND(v3_pred::numeric, 1) AS "v3 Pred (h)", CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN ROUND((v3_pred - elapsed_hours)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "v3 Error (h)", CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN (SELECT model_version || ' (CHAMPION)' FROM champ)      WHEN ABS(v3_pred - elapsed_hours) <= LEAST(ABS(v1_pred - elapsed_hours), ABS(v2_pred - elapsed_hours)) THEN 'v3_xgboost'      WHEN ABS(v2_pred - elapsed_hours) < ABS(v1_pred - elapsed_hours) THEN 'v2_gbt'      ELSE 'v1_baseline' END AS "Best / Active Model", event_time_utc + (CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN champ_pred ELSE LEAST(v1_pred, v2_pred, v3_pred) END * INTERVAL '1 hour') AS "Predicted Close (UTC)" FROM pivoted ORDER BY event_time_utc DESC;
